note: C-15 / C-19 (deny by evidence): the AI door's slice, the default since C-19 (NML_CORE_SLICE=allow is the way back; the human door keeps the allow file until DS-109). A unit carrying a listed primitive (unit or weapon rule) stays on the table; every other rule the registry automates goes to the core. Unknown or unautomated rules stay refused in both modes. Measured in the 24-game shadow soak of 17.11. (wave1116/shadow_soak_C6.md); the list only shrinks.
unmapped_inert_why: A rule name no rules map knows for the unit's system and faction (an upgrade's own label such as Wandering Mystic, War Paint, Combat Shield): the registry gives neither side anything to read, and the rules the upgrade grants are carried and checked on their own.

inert.Unique: A list-building restriction only (army book); no effect on a volley.
inert.Army Standard Bearer: An upgrade's own label; the rules it grants (Fear(2)) are carried and checked on their own.
inert.Courage: The bare base the Courage Aura expansion stamps; no map entry on either side - the +1 morale rides the aura's own Banner entry.

ledger_not_round_tripped.why: Their marker pools / once-per-game stamps do not come back from the core's delta yet (slice design 1d). Growth Markers measured: a joined hero's Piercing Growth AP differs between the core and the table (C-18 soak, Hive Swarms + Grunt Veteran). Hit & Run and Hit & Run Shooter lifted again (HR-POS): the delta carries the stepped positions and the table lands them (door probe 8/8).
ledger_not_round_tripped.leaves_with: C-12 / C-13 and the activation-level steps

pre_attack_beat_twice.why: The table resolves a bearer's pre-attack beat in main.gd before the volley, and the core, which takes the whole activation, resolves it again from the board it captured before that beat. Measured 19.11. (one real AI activation per seed, deny slice, door on against door off, 8 seeds each): Mend 8/8 and Breath Attack 8/8 roll the beat's die twice (a second Blast volley on 7/8), Mind Control (also Fatigue Debuff) 8/8 rolls its morale test twice, Storm Attack 8/8 rolls its trigger dice twice, Reckless Piercing 8/8 rolls its die twice, and the Utility Buff family leaves a stale once-record or marker behind on the table 8/8 (Precision Shooter Buff: a record the core already spent; Precision Tag: a tag marker). The family is one primitive, so its Casting Buff, Precision Target and Precision Spotter (each measured equal, 8/8) and Re-Position Artillery (not measured) go with it. Piercing Tag, Piercing Target and Piercing Spotter (primitive Piercing Tag) run in the same slot but measured equal 8/8 and stay taken (LD-6).

door_omits_to_hit_note.why: The table names every to-hit modifier a rule applies in one line (`To-hit vs <U>: Artillery +1 (Held, target over 12"), Stealth -1 -> hits on 3+`); the door says none of it. Measured 19.11. (dlines probe over the roster sweep, 1394 taken-and-equal volleys): 224 volleys, the largest gap, dlines_gap row 2. A rule applied without a log line.
door_omits_to_hit_note.leaves_with: the dlines2 train that composes the note on the core's step path

door_omits_wound_ignore_line.why: The table writes the ignore roll of the Regeneration family with the rule's name (`<U> rolls N Plaguebound dice (5+) - K wounds ignored`, the bypass and Warding lines); the door writes none and the core's context carries targets, not names. Measured 19.11.: 198 volleys, dlines_gap row 3.
door_omits_wound_ignore_line.leaves_with: the dlines2 train that carries the group names to the dice leg

door_omits_shred_line.why: The table names Shred's extra wounds (`Warbound: 2 Defense rolls of 1 -> +2 wounds`, the widened and Boost forms); the door writes none. Measured 19.11.: 80 volleys, dlines_gap row 7.
door_omits_shred_line.leaves_with: the dlines2 train that says the Shred lines

door_omits_lacerate_line.why: The table names Lacerate's re-roll (`Lacerate: <U> re-rolls N unmodified Defense 6s`); the door writes none (the core carries no name for it). Measured 19.11.: 12 volleys, dlines_gap row 13.
door_omits_lacerate_line.leaves_with: the dlines2 train that names the Bane family's re-roll

door_omits_takedown_lines.why: The table writes three Takedown lines (the pick, the unit-of-[1] save context, the picked model wounded or killed) and no `takes N wounds` line; the door writes `takes N wounds` instead. Measured 19.11.: 38 volleys, dlines_gap row 15.
door_omits_takedown_lines.leaves_with: the dlines2 train that says the Takedown lines

door_omits_shielded_line.why: The table says each Defense part a rule adds before the volley (`<U> is Shielded: +1 Defense (saves on 3+)`); the door writes none. Measured 19.11.: 31 volleys, dlines_gap row 17.
door_omits_shielded_line.leaves_with: the dlines2 train that composes the Defense parts

door_omits_shroud_line.why: The table names the range cut of the Ranged Shrouding family (`Wild Veil: <U> - weapon ranges against it 6" shorter (min 6")`); the door writes none (the rule name is not on the core's context). Measured 19.11.: 35 volleys, dlines_gap row 16.

door_omits_fortified_line.why: The table names the AP the Fortified family takes off (`Warden: <U> takes the hits at AP(1) instead of AP(2) - saves on 5+`); the door words it differently and only in its ledger. Measured 19.11.: 17 volleys, dlines_gap row 21.
